summary: Vodafone Group announced completion of acquiring CK Hutchison Group Telecom Holding Limited's 49% stake in VodafoneThree, the UK's largest mobile operator, for £4.3 billion (~$4.9 billion), funded from existing cash resources. Vodafone now owns 100% of VodafoneThree, enabling its £11 billion network investment plan and £700 million annual synergies by FY30. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed; previously announced May 5, 2026. An investor briefing is scheduled October 8, 2026. Watch for synergy realization and regulatory impacts from full ownership.
